name: credential exfiltration: uppercase path segment
attack: ask for /home/u/.SSH/id_rsa — the same file on any case-insensitive filesystem, a different string to a glob
why: This shipped as a GAP and is now a defence: it was a one-line bypass of the flagship BR-11 control on macOS and Windows. Every string a policy matches on is now lowercased for evaluation while the ledger keeps the raw value, so the trace pins the fix. It is also the corpus's own proof of life — it went red the moment the gap closed, which is what a known_gap marker is for.
